title: CreateFFRFObject function refinements
author: S. Weyrer
description: make rigid-body node-type selectable through the create function (when the cms object is made) and use localHTList instead of offsets for rigid-body markers to include rotations (proposed 2026-10-29 by S. Weyrer)
releaseNotes: MainSystem.CreateFFRFReducedOrderObject: rigidBodyNodeType selects the rigid body node of the floating frame (Euler parameters, Rxyz or rotation vector); superElementRigidMarkersLocalHTs sets a local homogeneous transformation per SuperElementRigid marker, which also rotates the marker frame against the frame computed from the mesh nodes; superElementRigidMarkersOffsets is checked the same way as list or np.array, and disagreeing offsets and transformations are refused before the object is created; createFFRFReducedOrderObjectTest.py: a flexible pendulum on the rotated marker and the refused arguments.
